Name: Cute Cottagecore Furniture for Alternative Textures
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sHoUQXE.png[/img]

If you prefer a catalog version to have these as unique items instead of retextures, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27584]Cute Cottagecore Catalog[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Zexu2K/about-me?gameId=1303]Zexu2K[/url]. They contacted me for permission on making it and did a fantastic job with it! I also drew a brand new sprite for the catalog itself. Definitely check that out if you prefer unique items over retextures.


I really like some of the vanilla furniture, but it's also just a little too plain for me. So I dressed them up! These are themed around a cute and simple cottagecore aesthetic. I may add additional colors in the future, so let me know if you have a request. :3

These are applied via Alternative Textures and affect the following furniture:
Single Bed
Double Bed
Blossom Rug
Large Red Rug
Patchwork Rug
Walnut Table
Walnut Bench
Dried Sunflowers
Clothesline
Wall Clock
Junimo Lamp
Funky Rug
Floor Cushion (brown)


This is my first little furniture set, so let me know if you experience any issues!



[img]https://i.imgur.com/lTKkn3N.png[/img]

Unzip the downloaded file and drop the folder "[AT] Cute Cottagecore Furniture by Luny" into StardewValley/mods. That's all! ^-^



If you'd like to support my mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]consider buying me a coffee[/url]. Don't feel obligated though. (￣▽￣*)ゞ I'm also hoping to accept commissions there in the future!
